clips.title: The story
paras: In Darnassus, young human and dwarven priests find guidance in another faith. Priestess Alathea teaches the ways of Elune, while followers of the Holy Light are directed to Stormwind. There, High Priestess Laurena welcomes the returning acolyte to the Cathedral of Light.

Alliance priests follow different sacred paths. In Darnassus, the priesthood tends to Elune, channeling the moon goddess's radiance and wrath. Priestess Alathea honors Elune and respects the Holy Light, but cannot teach another race the deeper prayers bound to a different devotion. Human and dwarven acolytes who seek those prayers must look elsewhere.

Initiates of the Holy Light return home to learn its rites, including the prayer for divine aid in a moment of peril. High Priestess Laurena guides returning priests in Stormwind's Cathedral of Light, beneath its marble arches.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Praise be to Elune, and to your Light, friend.
About this time, many of our order learn abilities reflecting their faith in Elune. If knowledge serves me, I believe the same holds true for your order also.
When your business in Darnassus is complete, I would seek out one of your High Priestesses for further training.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I'm glad you've arrived, friend. There are many things we will have to discuss, but more importantly is your training in the ways of the Light.
There are lessons all servants of the Light must learn. If you are ready, we'll begin discussing some of those now.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
